# The footballer, phase 2: the arms tilted out 12 degrees about the shoulders, Sheltzy32
# materials (sRGB of the ramp steps), one object, flat shading, export. Generated by make_player.py.
select SleeveL ArmL HandL Band
cursor set 0.260 0 1.13
origin set --to cursor
select SleeveL
active SleeveL
set rotation 0 -12 0
apply --rotation
select ArmL
active ArmL
set rotation 0 -12 0
apply --rotation
select HandL
active HandL
set rotation 0 -12 0
apply --rotation
select Band
active Band
set rotation 0 -12 0
apply --rotation
select SleeveR ArmR HandR
cursor set -0.260 0 1.13
origin set --to cursor
select SleeveR
active SleeveR
set rotation 0 12 0
apply --rotation
select ArmR
active ArmR
set rotation 0 12 0
apply --rotation
select HandR
active HandR
set rotation 0 12 0
apply --rotation
material new Shirt --base-color 0.925 0.380 0.290 --no-slot
material new Sock --base-color 0.925 0.380 0.290 --no-slot
material new Trim --base-color 0.800 0.886 0.882 --no-slot
material new Shorts --base-color 0.800 0.886 0.882 --no-slot
material new Skin --base-color 1.000 0.643 0.408 --no-slot
material new Hair --base-color 0.408 0.235 0.204 --no-slot
material new Boot --base-color 0.220 0.000 0.173 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 0.133 0.165 0.361 --no-slot
material new Band --base-color 1.000 0.855 0.439 --no-slot
select Torso SleeveL SleeveR
material assign Shirt
select Collar
material assign Trim
select Shorts
material assign Shorts
select Head ArmL HandL ArmR HandR KneeL KneeR
material assign Skin
select HairTop HairBack
material assign Hair
select EyeR EyeL
material assign Eye
select Band
material assign Band
select BootL BootR
material assign Boot
select SockL SockR
material assign Sock
select all
active Torso
join
rename Torso Player
shade flat
export player.glb
